categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in high-end semiconductor quality control, providing comprehensive yield management solutions including equipment products, intelligent software products, and related services. Its product portfolio covers semiconductor inspection and metrology equipment for various semiconductor manufacturing processes such as front-end wafer processing and advanced packaging. The company also offers software solutions that integrate AI and big data for yield enhancement in semiconductor manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced optical inspection technology, deep ultraviolet imaging scanning, multi-mode illumination systems, high-precision interferometry, and deep learning-based defect classification algorithms. It employs precision manufacturing and automated assembly for its semiconductor inspection and metrology equipment. The R&D process includes concept feasibility, alpha and beta stages, and mass production, supported by dedicated testing platforms for continuous innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic semiconductor manufacturers engaged in logic, memory, power semiconductors, MEMS, compound semiconductors (SiC, GaN, GaAs), advanced packaging (2.5D/3D, wafer-level packaging), large silicon wafer producers, and semiconductor equipment manufacturers (etching, thin film deposition, CMP). The company serves primarily the semiconductor manufacturing industry, focusing on front-end wafer fabs and advanced packaging sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with subsidiaries in major cities including Shenzhen, Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Xiamen, Chengdu, Wuhan, Zhuhai, Qingdao, and Tianjin. It also has overseas subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Singapore. The majority of revenue is generated from domestic markets, with a small but rapidly growing portion from overseas sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the upstream to midstream segment of the semiconductor equipment supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying semiconductor inspection and metrology equipment and software to semiconductor fabs and equipment manufacturers. It is positioned as a key equipment supplier supporting semiconductor production quality control and process monitoring.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in optical detection technology, deep ultraviolet imaging, AI-driven defect classification, and high-precision metrology. The company emphasizes expanding its product portfolio to cover all critical semiconductor manufacturing steps and advancing software integration for yield management. It plans to increase R&D investment, enhance talent development, and accelerate industrialization of new equipment series to meet evolving customer needs and support domestic semiconductor equipment localization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of semiconductor inspection and metrology equipment and related software products. The company also earns income from after-sales services and technical support. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels, supported by customer service teams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global semiconductor inspection and metrology equipment market is dominated by international giants such as KLA Corporation, Applied Materials, and Hitachi, with KLA holding a majority market share. The company competes as a leading domestic player in China, rapidly increasing its market share by leveraging localized services, competitive pricing, and technology innovation to challenge foreign incumbents in the Chinese market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 890.9 million, a 74.95% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 140.3 million, a significant turnaround from prior years. Total assets reached RMB 3.43 billion, doubling from the previous year, supported by a successful IPO raising nearly RMB 1.7 billion. The company maintains a high R&D investment ratio (~25.6% of revenue) and shows strong growth momentum in both scale and profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a comprehensive suite of semiconductor quality control solutions combining advanced optical inspection technologies, AI-powered software for defect classification and yield management, and localized customer support. Its products meet the stringent requirements of advanced semiconductor manufacturing processes, providing high sensitivity, throughput, and accuracy. The integration of equipment and intelligent software creates a closed-loop yield management system that enhances manufacturing efficiency and product quality, differentiating it from competitors.
